business_summary: Rheinmetall AG is a German defense and automotive-technology group listed on Xetra Frankfurt. Its Weapon and Ammunition and Vehicle Systems divisions make it one of Europe's largest artillery, propellant and armored-vehicle producers, with propellant powder plant expansion and a nitrocellulose feedstock acquisition both underway.

exposure_summary.narrative: Rheinmetall AG sits on 4 link(s) of the munitions-replenishment chain: Nitration feedstock chemistry (ammonia, nitric and acetic acid, cellulose) (position 1, QUIET); Energetic materials: RDX, HMX, IMX formulations, TNT and nitrocellulose (position 2, EMERGING); Artillery and bulk munitions output (position 11, CROWDED); Allied and European rearmament demand (position 12, OVER_CROWDED). Owns nitrocellulose production feeding its own artillery propellant manufacture, having agreed to buy a German industrial nitrocellulose maker to close the propellant raw-material bottleneck. Manufactures gun and artillery propellant powder and modular propellant charges, and is building one of Europe's largest powder plants at Aschau am Inn. Produces 155 mm artillery projectiles at its Unterlüß plant and is scaling toward high annual projectile volumes. European ammunition prime delivering allied artillery orders, including NATO member state funded deliveries to Ukraine. FY figures (period ended 2025-12-31): revenue €9,935,000,000 EUR, operating margin 17.1%, 15.7% 3-year revenue CAGR.
